Cash leads: I'm first (62.8M vs 35.7 and 26.8). Bribe reduces cash — bad. But influence matters for 5% commission bonus and president role in law? President is holder idx 0; in law phase, president = highest influence entering law. Max influence gets extra 5% bank (~3.15M). Currently all influence 1; rivals may act later this round and could bribe to take influence. I could bribe 5M to idx 2 to gain influence 2, but that costs 5M cash for 3.15M bonus... not worth it, unless rivals also do it. Also rank matters: 50:30:15 split of ~59.85M: my lead is comfortable. Best to pass (keep cash, vote_weight 1+? pass gives +2 weight? No—vote_weight plus 2 if action was skipped). Passing action gives +2 vote weight in law, useful to block bad laws (tax on sales—but no more sales... card 5 gives +1 influence to richest = me; card 4 to poorest). So pass is best.
